description: Fix 5 issues identified in semantic review: (1) 'para' stop-word false positive, (2) add confidence threshold for direct execution, (3) item field-fill dual-write, (4) TTS/mic timing race condition, (6) state desync on external modal close.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix 'para' stop-word: Remove 'para' from STOP_WORDS and change esStopWord to use exact match only (remove startsWith logic).
STEP 2 - Add confidence threshold: In despacharAccionIA, before calling ejecutarDirectoIA, check json.confianza >= 0.85. If below threshold, open modal pre-filled instead of executing directly.
STEP 3 - Fix item dual-write: In llenarCampoPorVoz campo='item', remove the direct push to estado.itemsOrden and only click #o-add, then fill the newly created row.
STEP 4 - Fix TTS/mic timing race: In hablarAgente, add polling fallback that checks speechSynthesis.speaking every 200ms if onend doesn't fire within 5s.
STEP 5 - Fix state desync on modal close: Add hook to cerrarModal and modal close listeners that resets asistente.estadoAgente='libre' and asistente.modalTipo=null when modal is closed externally.
STEP 6 - Verify syntax: NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check src/renderer/renderer.js && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check functions/index.js
acceptance_criteria: STOP_WORDS no longer contains 'para'; esStopWord uses exact match only
Direct execution requires confianza >= 0.85; below threshold opens pre-filled modal
llenarCampoPorVoz for item does not dual-write (only clicks #o-add OR only pushes to state)
hablarAgente has polling fallback for when onend doesn't fire
Closing modal externally resets asistente.estadoAgente to 'libre'
findings: All 5 fixes applied successfully. (1) Removed 'para' from STOP_WORDS and changed esStopWord to exact-match only. (2) Added confianza >= 0.85 threshold for direct execution; below threshold opens pre-filled modal. (3) Removed direct push to estado.itemsOrden in llenarCampoPorVoz item handler; now only clicks #o-add then fills the last row. (4) Added polling interval (200ms) in hablarAgente that checks speechSynthesis.speaking as fallback when onend does not fire. (6) Added try/catch in cerrarModal to reset asistente.estadoAgente to 'libre' and asistente.modalTipo to null when modal closes externally. Issue 5 (unauthenticated Cloud Function) skipped as pre-existing/out-of-scope. v2 review fixes: (7) Added actualizarHerramientaDespacho loop in ejecutarDirectoIA after registrarOrden for tool dispatches. (8) Replaced synchronous success announcement in confirmarModalPorVoz with modal-close observer (setInterval checks #modal.hidden every 300ms, 10s timeout for error fallback).
